faqs.question: How do I apply for admission?
faqs.answer: You can apply through our online portal at admissions.college.edu. Register with your email, fill out the application form, and upload the required documents.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for undergrad courses?
faqs.answer: Minimum 60% in high school (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry, and Math as compulsory subjects for Engineering, or relevant subjects for other streams.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply?
faqs.answer: The application deadline for the Fall 2024 semester is July 30th. Early bird applications close on June 15th.

faqs.question: Are there any scholarships available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer merit-based and need-based scholarships. Students with >90% in boards are eligible for a 50% tuition waiver.

faqs.question: What documents are required for admission?
faqs.answer: You need your 10th and 12th marksheets, a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/Passport), transfer certificate, and migration certificate.

faqs.question: Is there an entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, we conduct the College Entrance Test (CET) for all major programs. Scores from JEE and NEET are also accepted.

faqs.question: Is there an interview process?
faqs.answer: Shortlisted candidates for Management and Design courses are required to attend a personal interview round.

faqs.question: What is the admission refund policy?
faqs.answer: Full refund is available if withdrawn 15 days before the semester starts. A 10% processing fee applies thereafter.

faqs.question: Do you accept international students?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a dedicated International Student Office to assist with admissions, visas, and accommodation.

faqs.question: Do you allow lateral entry?
faqs.answer: Yes, students with a diploma can apply for lateral entry into the 2nd year of B.Tech programs.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for Computer Science?
faqs.answer: The CS curriculum covers Data Structures, Algorithms, AI, Web Development, and Cloud Computing across 8 semesters.

faqs.question: Tell me about the Mechanical Engineering course.
faqs.answer: Our Mech department focuses on Robotics, Thermodynamics, and Automotive design with state-of-the-art labs.

faqs.question: How does the credit system work?
faqs.answer: Each course carries 3-4 credits. A total of 160 credits are required for graduation in B.Tech.

faqs.question: Can I choose minor subjects?
faqs.answer: Yes, from the 3rd semester, students can choose minor subjects in fields like Psychology, Photography, or Finance.

faqs.question: Are internships mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, a 6-week summer internship is mandatory at the end of the 6th semester.

faqs.question: What are the placement statistics?
faqs.answer: Last year, 95% of graduates were placed with an average package of $85,000 per annum.

faqs.question: Who are the core faculty members?
faqs.answer: Our faculty includes PhD holders from top global universities and industry veterans with decades of experience.

faqs.question: Are there any online courses?
faqs.answer: We offer several certification programs online, but degree programs are currently on-campus only.

faqs.question: What research facilities are available?
faqs.answer: We have 15 specialized research labs, including an Innovation Hub and a Nano-Tech Center.

faqs.question: What is the minimum attendance requirement?
faqs.answer: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance to be eligible for final examinations.

faqs.question: Is hostel mandatory for all students?
faqs.answer: No, it's optional. However, freshers are encouraged to stay in the hostel for better integration.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the hostel?
faqs.answer: Hostel fees range from $1,500 to $2,500 per semester depending on the room type (Single/Double, AC/Non-AC). This includes mess charges.

faqs.question: Is food included in the hostel fee?
faqs.answer: The hostel fee includes 4 meals a day (Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks, and Dinner).

faqs.question: What are the hostel timings?
faqs.answer: Students must return to the hostel by 9:30 PM. Late entry requires prior permission from the warden.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi available in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Yes, high-speed 5G Wi-Fi is available 24/7 across all hostel blocks.

faqs.question: Are there laundry facilities?
faqs.answer: Every floor has card-operated washing machines and dryers. Dry cleaning services are also available on-site.

faqs.question: Is there a gym in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Yes, each hostel block has a mini-gym and a common room for indoor games like Table Tennis.

faqs.question: What if I fall sick in the hostel?
faqs.answer: A resident doctor and ambulance are available on-call 24/7. The nearest hospital is only 5 minutes away.

faqs.question: Can my parents stay in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Parents can stay for up to 2 days in the guest house with a nominal fee and prior booking.

faqs.question: Is the hostel safe?
faqs.answer: We have a zero-tolerance policy for ragging. 24/7 CCTV surveillance and security guards ensure student safety.

faqs.question: What are the library hours?
faqs.answer: The central library is open from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays and 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekends.

faqs.question: How many canteens are on campus?
faqs.answer: There are 3 major food courts and several snack kiosks offering a variety of cuisines.

faqs.question: What sports facilities do you have?
faqs.answer: We have a football field, cricket ground, basketball courts, and an Olympic-size swimming pool.

faqs.question: Is parking available for students?
faqs.answer: Yes, designated parking zones are available for two-wheelers and four-wheelers. Cycles are encouraged.

faqs.question: Is there an ATM on campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a 24-hour ATM and a branch of Global Bank located near the administration block.

faqs.question: Do you have an auditorium?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a 1500-seater fully air-conditioned auditorium for major events and guest lectures.

faqs.question: Is there a college bus service?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide shuttle services across the city. You can register for the bus service annually.

faqs.question: Do you support startups?
faqs.answer: Our Incubation Center provides mentorship, workspace, and seed funding for student-led startups.

faqs.question: Where can I access computers?
faqs.answer: Computer labs are located in every department, and the central IT block is open 18 hours a day.

faqs.question: Are there printing shops on campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, stationery and printing shops are located in the student center and near each hostel block.

faqs.question: When is the annual cultural fest?
faqs.answer: Our annual fest, 'Aura', usually takes place in the second week of February each year.

faqs.question: Do you host any hackathons?
faqs.answer: Yes, 'CodeStorm' is our flagship 24-hour national hackathon held every October.

faqs.question: When is the convocation ceremony?
faqs.answer: Convocation is typically held in May for students who graduated in the previous academic year.

faqs.question: How can I join a student club?
faqs.answer: We have over 40 clubs! You can sign up during the 'Club Fair' which happens in the first week of September.

faqs.question: Are there any workshops this month?
faqs.answer: Check the events calendar on our website for the latest schedules. This month we have a workshop on AI and Ethics.

faqs.question: When is the annual sports meet?
faqs.answer: The Inter-College Sports Meet 'Arena' is scheduled for November 15-20.

faqs.question: When is the orientation for new students?
faqs.answer: Orientation for the Class of 2024 begins on August 1st and lasts for three days.

faqs.question: Is there an alumni meet?
faqs.answer: Yes, 'Grand Reunion' is held every December, inviting alumni from across the globe.

faqs.question: Do you host TEDx events?
faqs.answer: Yes, TEDxCollegeCity is an annual event that features inspiring talks from various fields.

faqs.question: Are there any social service events?
faqs.answer: The NSS unit organizes blood donation camps and teaching drives in nearby villages every semester.

faqs.question: What is the tuition fee?
faqs.answer: Tuition fees vary by program. On average, it ranges from $5,000 to $12,000 per academic year for most degree programs.

faqs.question: What is the exam fee?
faqs.answer: Exam fees are $100 per semester. Backlog exam fees are $20 per subject.
